source.title: UK padel has doubled, but there's subtlety beneath it. | The Court Report

verified_atoms.claim: In the twelve months to August 2025 the UK approved 312 padel planning applications with 629 lodged.
verified_atoms.source_quote:
In the twelve months to August 2025 the UK approved 312
padel planning applications with 629 lodged.

verified_atoms.claim: Applications approved were 649 from 312, up 108%.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 649 Applications approved From 312 +108%

verified_atoms.claim: Applications lodged were 1,150 from 629, up 83%.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 1,150 Applications lodged From 629 +83%

verified_atoms.claim: Courts approved were 945 from 456, up 107%.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 945 Courts approved From 456 +107%

verified_atoms.claim: Approval rate was 86% from 87%.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 86% Approval rate From 87%. Unchanged.

verified_atoms.claim: Median decision time was 85 days from 84 days.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 85 Median decision, days From 84. Unchanged.

verified_atoms.claim: Average scheme size was 2.68 courts from 2.64 courts.
verified_atoms.source_quote: 2.68 Average scheme, courts From 2.64. Unchanged.

verified_atoms.claim: December alone carried 131 applications, the biggest month on record.
verified_atoms.source_quote:
December alone carried 131
applications, the biggest month on record

verified_atoms.claim: In March there were 70 approvals against 115 submissions.
verified_atoms.source_quote:
In March there were 70
approvals against 115 submissions.

verified_atoms.claim: By July it was 72 approvals against 93 submissions.
verified_atoms.source_quote: By July it was 72 against 93.

the small end grew close to four times faster, from 88 approvals
